# Replace fringe_adaptive with anneal in pipeline; use grow → anneal → hill (new combination, extend sizes 6–20)

Current grow branch (fringe→grow→hill, score 1.0251) clusters around boundary-focused preprocessing. Anneal achieved 1.0467 in the anneal branch, proving it's highly effective for escaping local optima. By replacing fringe (boundary-extract) with anneal (probabilistic exploration), we create a structurally new pipeline: grow expands boundaries → anneal escapes local traps → hill refines. This untried combination (grow→anneal→hill) respects grow direction while leveraging anneal's proven escape power. Extended size range [6,8,10,12,14,16,18,20] matches t1_b2_a2's successful multi-size strategy. Risk: anneal may undo grow's work if expansions don't help gamma; but worst case we're only slightly worse than grow-only baseline (1.0161). Upside: could reach 1.03+ by combining expansion with exploration.
